record.reason: DLR-Lock replaces MLPs with deep low-rank residual networks to make fine-tuning attacks more expensive; the paper explicitly exploits training-versus-inference asymmetry and targets backward-pass cost. It is a model-security/anti-fine-tuning method, not inference optimization.
record.title: Locking Pretrained Weights via Deep Low-Rank Residual Distillation
